title: Lil Wayne Reveals Top 2 Rappers, Favorite Alien & Why He Hates Milk: ‘I Just Can’t Look at It’
summary: The rap legend sat down with the Friends Keep Secrets podcast for an interesting conversation.
contentText:
Lil Wayne was an open book during his recent appearance on Lil Dicky , Benny Blanco and Kristin Batalucco’s podcast Friends Keep Secrets .

During a conversation about how he watched mostly Naked and Afraid and sports while he was behind bars, the New Orleans rapper admitted that Ancient Aliens is a guilty pleasure of his when he’s not watching sports.

“I love everything about  Ancient Aliens ,” he admitted after Batalucco asked if he watched the 2025 documentary The Age of Disclosure . “But that [documentary],  Age of Disclosure , that’s when they’re exposing everything that the government is watching.”

He then said we still don’t truly know the real truth about aliens while also bringing up the conspiracy theory that an extraterrestrial by the name of “J-Rod” survived an alleged UFO crash that happened in Kingsman, Arizona, in 1953. “We also have to understand what an alien is,” Wayne said. “None of us know. We don’t even know if they’re from another planet. The only alien that we supposedly knew is the one from Roswell that lived, J-Rod.”

He added: “J -Rod said, ‘I’m not from another planet.’ He said, ‘I’m from another time.’ He said that your world will end in a cataclysm, and some people will make it — a lot of people will — and they’ll have to live within the planet, basically going like ants. And that civilization, that time, will last so long that we’ll adapt to living there, and just like we adapt to everything else, we’re gonna start adapting to being an insect, devoid of light. That’s why alien eyes are so big because wherever they came from, there’s no light and the atmosphere is so dense. That’s why they don’t grow too tall because the atmosphere don’t allow them to. They don’t eat the same food, that’s why don’t get so big like that.”

Elsewhere in the podcast, Weezy revealed that he eats “breakfast for dinner a lot” and that he’s not the biggest fan of milk even though its essential when enjoying a bowl of cereal. “I don’t do milk, and I still eat cereal. I put milk in it; I just can’t look at it,” he said. “I don’t eat a lot of things that are white and soft. So, like, mashed potatoes I don’t f— with. Ranch, I can’t do. Stuff like mayonnaise, nothing. Milk is the only thing, and white rice. That’s the only thing I can do.”

Oh, and we almost forgot: When asked who his favorite rappers were, Wayne answered with Jay-Z ( despite the supposed Super Bowl snub ) and Missy Elliott .
